thread:
anita: Heads-up — planning rollout for the 'fast-route' routing flag. Goal: improve tail latency for multi-tenant routing without harming quality. Proposal: 3-phase rollout (internal alpha, geo-limited beta, global ramp). Auto-fallback if p95 > 750ms or error_rate > 1% for 5m. Need signoff on slices, canary signals, and tenant opt-out behavior.
cheng: 👍 agree. Recommend mirror shadowing first: mirror 100% traffic for 24h (no responses) to gather regressions. Start real traffic at 1% internal + synthetic tests.
matt: Also add A/B eval for quality: run a 20k prompt eval set against baseline vs fast-route. Keep kill-switch flag available as tenant and global. Ops should get alerts for cost delta too (tokens/call).
elaine: Oncall notes: baseline p95 ~220ms. Suggest condition = (p95 > 2x baseline) OR (p95 > 750ms) sustained for 3 windows (5m each) to trigger automatic rollback. Also add error-rate > 1% for same window. We'll add these to the runbook.
maria: Customer ask: several enterprise tenants require explicit opt-out. We'll expose tenant-scoped flag and an API for tenant admins to opt-out. Need to confirm SLA impact in customer comms.
anita: Flag and slices proposal: name = routing.fast_route.v1; slices = [internal, beta_cohorts, geo_na_eu, global_ramp]. Beta_cohorts = list of tenant IDs (we'll keep small). Can we map slices to priority queues for shedding?
cheng: Fallback ordering idea: 1) same model quantized variant -> 2) compatible model family (smaller) -> 3) legacy baseline route. We'll implement circuit-breaker at rack-region level to avoid wide blast radius.
matt: Telemetry + operator commands (examples):
```
/flag set routing.fast_route.v1 --slice=beta_cohorts --pct=5
/flag set routing.fast_route.v1 --slice=geo_na_eu --pct=5
/monitor create alert routing.latency.p95 --threshold=750 --window=5m --action=rollback:routing.fast_route.v1
```
Make sure metrics have tags: rollout_id, cohort, tenant_id.
anita: Can we wire automated rollback rules? e.g., if (p95>threshold OR err_rate>threshold) for 3 windows then rollback to previous flag state. Owners will be responsible for confirming post-rollback diagnostics.
elaine: Yes — we have an automation hook for the 3-window rule. I'll attach the automation policy to rollout_id once cheng creates the rollout object. I'll also update playbook steps for oncall.
maria: Timeline ask from sales: enterprise opt-out must be in place by EOD Friday for customer notifications. Is that feasible?
anita: Proposed timeline: Mon 09:00 internal alpha (1%), Mon 09:30 start 24h shadowing, Wed deploy beta_cohorts + geo_na_eu at 5% + run A/B eval, Fri morning global ramp to 30% if signals green. Owners: cheng (implementation), matt (telemetry/alerts), elaine (runbook & automation), maria (customer comms).
cheng: I'll build the canary dashboard (p95 heatmap by region + error surge matrix) and post link. Will also add the fallback ordering into routing config.
deploy-bot: Deployment note: dry-run canary scheduled 2025-02-11T15:00:00Z. Will post result and rollout_id when available.
anita: Thanks — please ack here with any blockers. If none, we'll lock slices + alerts by EOD today and create rollout object.
